title: Senior Enterprise Applications Administrator
description: Overview: About JAGGAER JAGGAER is a global provider of AI-powered procurement software for complex sourcing, supply and spend. More than 1,400 global enterprises across manufacturing, public sector, higher education and other industries use our platform to manage sourcing, contracts, invoicing, payments and supplier relationships in one place. JAGGAER One connects Source-to-Contract, Procure-to-Pay and Supplier Intelligence, with embedded AI (JAI) that helps teams move faster, stay compliant and make better decisions. Job Title: Senior Enterprise Applications Administrator Department – Enterprise Applications Reports to – EA Manager What We’re Looking For: Leads technical and functional administration, support, maintenance, and stability of the Salesforce platform, including Sales, Service, and Marketing Clouds. This includes leading administration of additional vendor modules and internally developed applications. Partners closely with internal and external developers, platform management, and business stakeholders. Evaluates and guides standard Salesforce seasonal releases to ensure minimal business impact. Supports application monitoring, troubleshooting, and issue resolution processes in complex environment. Leads administration of all lower salesforce environments, including dev, QA, training, and UAT. Leads technical evaluation, installation and configuration of managed packages and assists key stakeholders with evaluation and testing. Acts as an expert technical resource to platform stakeholders. Provides feedback and recommendations to leadership on platform optimization, security, and stability. Principal Responsibilities: Key Responsibilities: Collaborates with business leaders to align Salesforce capabilities with strategic goals and roadmap planning. Ensures compliance with data governance, privacy, and security policies across all Salesforce environments. Identifies opportunities for automation and process optimization using Flows, Process Builder, and Apex triggers. Leads user training initiatives and creates knowledge resources to improve adoption and self-service capabilities. Develops and maintains dashboards and reports to track system health, usage trends, and SLA adherence. Manage the end-to-end project lifecycle including planning, execution, monitoring, and closure, ensuring alignment with business goals and timely delivery. Partners with enterprise architects and integration teams to ensure seamless data flow between Salesforce and other enterprise systems (e.g., Netsuite, Concur). Collaborates directly within a team of other system administrators. Works directly with internal and external developers and other teams to resolve complex technical issues. title: Software Tester / QA Engineer
description: Experience: 3–6 Years Education: B.E. / B.Tech / B.Sc. in Computer Science, IT, or equivalent Work Location: On-site Industry: Defence Technology | Surveillance | AI | Real-Time Video Systems Job Description We are looking for an experienced Software Tester / QA Engineer to validate an integrated Surveillance & Command System involving real-time EO/IR video feeds, AI-based detection overlays, geospatial maps, alerts, and operator workflows. The ideal candidate will have strong experience in functional, regression, negative, exploratory, and performance/soak testing of complex web and backend applications. Experience with video streaming, AI/ML products, real-time systems, or multi-sensor platforms will be highly preferred. You will be responsible for identifying critical issues before deployment, validating end-to-end system behavior, and ensuring product reliability under realistic operational conditions. Key Responsibilities Execute release test plans across edge agents, central backend systems, and operator-facing web applications. Validate multi-feed EO/IR video, synchronization, AI overlays, confidence thresholds, object tracking, and playback/replay functionality. Perform functional, regression, exploratory, negative, and soak testing. Validate REST APIs and React-based operator interfaces, including live video, maps, alerts, reports, settings, and authentication. Test failure scenarios such as UDP packet loss, delayed camera connections, WebRTC reconnections, GPU overload, and AI engine failures. Maintain golden video clips and scenario-based test suites for validating model and sensor-fusion changes. Identify, document, and track defects with clear reproduction steps, expected vs. actual results, logs, screenshots, and video evidence. Perform regression testing after software, AI model, configuration, and engine updates. Coordinate with developers, system engineers, and operators during integration and acceptance testing. Prepare test reports and evidence packages to support certification and release readiness. Required Skills & Experience 3–6 years of experience in Software Testing / Quality Assurance for complex web and backend applications. Strong understanding of manual testing, exploratory testing, regression testing, and test case design. Experience in REST API testing using Postman or Insomnia. Experience testing React-based web applications and browser-based operator interfaces. Exposure to real-time video streaming, AI/ML applications, video analytics, or multi-sensor systems. Understanding of video synchronization, detection overlays, object classification, tracking behavior, and confidence thresholds. Experience designing regression scenarios and maintaining test suites for frequently changing applications. Knowledge of negative testing, network failure simulation, and long-duration soak testing. Basic scripting knowledge in Python, JavaScript, or TypeScript. Familiarity with Git, browser DevTools, test management tools, and screen/video capture utilities. Ability to troubleshoot issues across browsers, desktop GPUs, edge devices, and different network environments. Good to Have Experience with Playwright, Cypress, Jest, or Vitest. Exposure to NVIDIA Jetson or other edge computing platforms. Experience with WebRTC, UDP, RTSP, or other video streaming technologies. Understanding of geospatial interfaces, map-based applications, and location-based alerts. Experience in defence, surveillance, command-and-control, or mission-critical software products. ISTQB certification is an added advantage but not mandatory. What We Are Looking For A detail-oriented QA professional who can identify complex system-level defects. Someone who understands end-to-end product behavior rather than focusing only on individual modules. Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving abilities. Ability to work closely with engineering teams and operational users during on-site integration. Experience preparing structured test plans, defect reports, and release validation evidence. Preferred Candidate Profile Candidates with prior experience in any of the following domains will be strongly preferred: Real-time video surveillance systems EO/IR camera systems AI-based video analytics Object detection and tracking platforms Multi-camera or multi-sensor applications Geospatial and command-and-control systems Edge computing and mission-critical applications How to Apply: Interested candidates can apply through Indeed with an updated resume highlighting relevant QA experience, automation exposure, video/AI product testing experience, and examples of complex defects identified during pre-release testing. Pay: ₹450,000.00 - ₹850,000.00 per year Ability to commute/relocate: Hyderabad, Telangana: Reliably commute or planning to relocate before starting work (Required) Application Question(s): How many years of relevant experience do you hold for Software testing? What is your Highest Qualification? Work Location: In person
